title: Storing and shelving a set
target: How boxes, packs and shelves line up by set in TCG Card Shop Simulator, so a collection is stored and displayed by what it belongs to.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)
prerequisites: Cards from more than one set
A shelf for cards and somewhere for storage
Enough space to sort by set

steps.do: Expect the game to ship a box for each rarity rather than one box.
steps.because: the game ships a card box for each rarity: rare, epic and legend (RareCardBox, EpicCardBox, LegendCardBox)

steps.do: Expect a parallel set of boxes for the later expansion.
steps.because: the later expansion has a parallel set of boxes for the same rarities (Destiny_RareCardBox, Destiny_EpicCardBox, Destiny_LegendCardBox)

steps.do: Know that bulk supply boxes are pictured per rarity and per grade.
steps.because: bulk supply boxes are pictured per rarity and per grade (Icon_BulkBox_TetramonBase, Icon_BulkBox_TetramonBaseHG, Icon_BulkBox_TetramonBaseUG, Icon_BulkBox_TetramonDestiny)

steps.do: Keep a set's packs with the set, because each pack is tied to an expansion.
steps.because: each pack is tied to an expansion and the later sets have packs of their own (ExpansionTetramon, AscensionCardPack, MegabotPack, FoodieGOPack, FantasyRPGPack, CatJobPack)

steps.do: Expect a set to supply a front, an icon and a background for its cards.
steps.because: the game supplies a front, an icon and a background for a card of a set, including full-art fronts (CardFrontIconOnly, AscensionCardFrontIcon, CardFront_Air, CardFront_Destiny, CardFrontFullArt_Air, CardFrontFullArt_Water, CardFrontFullArt_Fire)

steps.do: Put each kind of fixture where the manager expects it.
steps.because: a manager holds a separate list for shelves, cashier counters, card shelves, combined shelves, prize shelves, play tables, workbenches, empty-box storage and donation boxes (ShelfManager, m_ShelfList, m_CashierCounterList, m_CardShelfList, m_CardItemCombiShelfList, m_TournamentPrizeShelfList, m_PlayTableList, m_WorkbenchList, m_EmptyBoxStorageList, m_BulkDonationBoxList)

steps.do: Know that card storage is listed apart from card shelves.
steps.because: card storage shelves are listed apart from card shelves (m_CardStorageShelfList)

commonMistakes: Sorting a later set into the base set's boxes.
Storing packs by size rather than by the set they belong to.
Treating card storage as if it were a card shelf.
Assuming one shelf kind is interchangeable with another.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
